Notion Workshop Bengaluru

​Join us for a hands-on Notion workshop where you'll learn how to organize your work, build powerful databases, and explore new ways to use Notion beyond note-taking.

​Join the WhatsApp group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/KDKxVkshWEa1Z86fzJ8Za9

​What you'll learn:

  • ​🧩 Notion basics and workspace setup

  • ​🗂️ Building and managing Notion databases

  • ​🛠️ Hands-on workflows using Notion as a backend

  • ​🤖 Exploring AI agents with Notion

​📅 Date: 21st November 2026
⏰ Time: 11:00 AM – 1:00 PM
📍 Venue: Dodo Payments Office, Bengaluru

​Whether you're new to Notion or looking to explore its capabilities, this workshop will help you build practical workflows and discover what's possible with Notion.

​Come learn, build, and explore the future of productivity with Notion!

Build Bengaluru 2.0 — 24-Hour Hackathon

Join Group for Important updates - https://chat.whatsapp.com/KFrYRhF3ETq9yf0NSUuEDj

HackBriven presents Build Bengaluru 2.0, a 24-hour hackathon bringing together developers, innovators, AI enthusiasts, and aspiring founders at Newton School Campus, Bengaluru, in community partnership with Google for Developers.

Get ready for 24 hours of building, learning, and innovation. Collaborate with fellow builders, solve real-world problems, and turn your ideas into impactful solutions.


Eligibility Criteria: Only students are eligible to participate in Build Bengaluru 2.0. 🎓

Hackathon Structure

Round 1: Online Screening

Round 2: Online PPT Submission

Round 3: Offline Finale

What's waiting for you?

  • 24-Hour Hackathon: Build real-world solutions.

  • AI & Tech Learning: Explore AI and emerging technologies.

  • Cloud Credits: Access developer resources.

  • Goodies & Swag: Get exclusive merchandise.

  • Certificates: Earn recognition for your participation.

  • Networking: Connect with developers, founders, and industry experts.

  • Mentorship: Learn and collaborate with fellow builders.

  • Prize Pool: Win prizes worth up to ₹50,000.

  • Free Meals: Stay fuelled throughout the hackathon.

Venue: Newton School Campus, Bengaluru
Date: 21-22 November
Duration: 24 Hours
Community Partner: Google for Developers
Organised by: HackBriven

More than just a hackathon, this is an opportunity to learn, innovate, collaborate, and build something meaningful.

Join Build Bengaluru 2.0 and turn your ideas into reality!
